Messages.Body:
Hy,
i need some answers for the following:

can Compel the Spirit rescue a burned jake washington (hunter) ?
can CtS move from the grave a burned retainer created via death pact ?

can daemonic possession (or possession, or augustus's ability),
move a burned vampire created via the embrace
(or similar means, like third tradition/abomination/creation rites) ?

thanks in advance

Emiliano , v:ekn prince of Rome

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>can Compel the Spirit rescue a burned jake washington (hunter) ?
>can CtS move from the grave a burned retainer created via death pact ?
>
>can daemonic possession (or possession, or augustus's ability),
> move a burned vampire created via the embrace
>(or similar means, like third tradition/abomination/creation rites) ?

No to all of them because they do not count as allies/retainers/vampires while
in the ash heap. While in the ash heap, they are simply minion or master cards
respectively. Similarly, when in your hand, Jake Washington counts as a Master
card not an Ally card (in regards to Egothha's special and Cull the Herd).

Halcyan 2

Messages.Body:
tetragrammaton wrote:
> As a side note: why such a "vampire" (created via an embrace, for ex)
> can be still influenced if he's banished back in the uncotrolled region
> (where it is not longer "in play"),
> and does not count as "vampire" while in the ash heap (still "not in play"

Cards in the ash heap are merely what they say they are.

The vampire moved to the uncontrolled region has been ruled (some would
say arbitrarily) to still be a vampire.
